mission: GuiAgentLoopCore provides the core logic for bridging GUI frameworks and LLM agents, managing conversation flow, agent interactions, and state control.

target_users.Application Developers: Building LLM-powered applications with GUI interfaces

target_users.AI Agent Developers: Creating specialized agents for specific tasks

target_users.AI Agents: Claude, Gemini, Codex, and other AI models working with this codebase

core_value: Reliable, type-safe, and extensible foundation for GUI-LLM integration with predictable state management and clear component boundaries.

design_philosophy.description: We prioritize system correctness over developer convenience. Hard invariants cannot be bypassed.
All state transitions, message types, and agent roles are explicitly defined. No magic behavior.
Each component has a single, well-defined responsibility. Clear boundaries between components.
All behavior is testable. Hard invariants have automated tests.
All terminology is normalized and defined in a formal ontology. No ambiguity.
